name: Spirit and Opportunity

locations.label: Spirit (MER-A), Columbia Memorial Station, Gusev Crater
Opportunity (MER-B), Challenger Memorial Station, Meridiani Planum

summary: Twin robotic rovers searched opposite sides of Mars for evidence of ancient liquid water.
hook: We were twin rovers built for 90 days that explored Mars for over fourteen years.
how_it_worked: Six-wheel rocker-bogie rovers equipped with panoramic cameras, mineral spectrometers, and rock abrasion tools.
science: Discovered hematite blueberries and silica deposits proving liquid water once covered ancient Martian terrain.

facts.text: Opportunity drove more than 45 kilometers on Mars, an off-world driving record that stood until Perseverance passed it.
Spirit discovered ancient hydrothermal silica deposits while dragging a broken front wheel.

image.alt: Self-portrait by the Opportunity rover on Mars in January 2014, about three weeks before completing a decade of work
